source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: The companion trails off after the account of abuse, giving Rafael room to respond. Keep the name substitution and pause.

exchange_context.Japanese:
FOの噂は
聞いてるよ。少なくとも、あんたらは
住民を虐待するようなマネは
しないだろ？
exchange_context.English:
I've heard about FO before.
 At least you wouldn't mistreat 
 the people here, would you?

exchange_context.Japanese: FI…
exchange_context.English: FI…

exchange_context.Japanese:
…これ、新大陸全体で起こっている問題
なんじゃないかって気がする
マルドナードだけじゃなく
他の勢力も…
exchange_context.English:
...This may be a problem across
 the whole New World, not just
 Maldonado. Other factions too...

exchange_context.Japanese:
だから、ヤツさえ倒せば解決するって
いうわけにはいかないんじゃ
ないかな。倒すにしても準備が
いるし…
exchange_context.English:
So defeating him alone 
 may not solve the problem. 
 And we'd need time to prepare, even
 for that...

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Arcadius notices Rafael is uneasy and waits for him to explain. Keep the unfinished address and its pause.

exchange_context.Japanese: あの子のことが気になるの？
exchange_context.English: You care for her?

exchange_context.Japanese:
ふうっ…。アルカディウスに
隠しごとはできないね
exchange_context.English:
Whew... I can't hide anything
 from you, can I?

exchange_context.Japanese: FI…
exchange_context.English: FI…

exchange_context.Japanese:
いつもあの子のことばかり考えてる…
何かしてあげたい気持ちで一杯なんだ！
だけど…だけど……！
exchange_context.English:
I can't stop thinking about her... 
 I want so badly to do something
 for her! But... But...!

exchange_context.Japanese:
FI…。あの子もね
毎日FIの
ことばかり考えてるって言っていたわ
exchange_context.English:
FI... She told me, "I think
 about FI all day, every day."

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: The surrounding exclamations use symbols for speech the crew cannot understand. Keep the recognizably opaque outburst and its emphatic punctuation.

exchange_context.Japanese:
わ、分かりませんや！何者かが
街の砲台を乗っ取っちまった
ようですぜ！
exchange_context.English:
I-I don't know! Looks like

 gun batteries!

exchange_context.Japanese: ！！　あれは！？
exchange_context.English: Is that...?!

exchange_context.Japanese: ぐわあああーっ！
exchange_context.English: Waaaaah!

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Hodram hesitates and qualifies his refusal after Lil challenges his reaction to the swap. Keep the reluctant double negative and opening pause.

exchange_context.Japanese:
やりー！！
やっぱ気が変わったなんてのなしよ！！
んじゃねっ！
exchange_context.English: Yes! No changing your mind! See you!

exchange_context.Japanese:
えーっ！？
覇者の証だよー、いらないの？？
exchange_context.English: What?! Don't you want the Proof?

exchange_context.Japanese: …いらないわけではない
exchange_context.English: …It's not that I don't want it.

exchange_context.Japanese:
でしょでしょー！　はい
これあげるから、ちょーだいっ！！
exchange_context.English:
Exactly! Here, take this.
 Now give me the wristband!

exchange_context.Japanese:
わーーーっ！！
ホントだ、かわいーーーっっ！！
やっりぃー！！　じゃーねー！！
exchange_context.English: Wow! So cute! Yes! Bye!

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Sera trails off as she takes in Hodram’s kindness about her memory and his praise of her cooking. Keep the address and pause.

exchange_context.Japanese: 言葉を覚える前に言ったことを…
exchange_context.English:
You remember what I said before
 you learned the language...

exchange_context.Japanese:
構わん。気にするな
おまえの料理はなかなか評判だ
誰も反対はしない
exchange_context.English:
Don't worry about that.
 Your cooking's well liked. 
 No one will object.

exchange_context.Japanese: FI…
exchange_context.English: FI…

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: The speaker calls out to the captain, then bursts into speech represented by opaque symbols in Japanese. Keep both the name substitution and the visible distinction.

exchange_context.Japanese:
FI、危ない
聞いた。私の国の仲間と
伝説の王助けるため、ここに来た
exchange_context.English:
I heard you were in danger, FI.
 I came with others from my homeland
 to help the king of legend.

exchange_context.Japanese:
おかげで命拾いをした
みんな、すまなかった
exchange_context.English:
You saved my life. Everyone... 
 I'm sorry.

exchange_context.Japanese:
ああ、本当にありがとう
さあ、みんな早く逃げたほうがいい
オスマン軍もだまってはいないだろう
exchange_context.English:
Yes, thank you. Truly. Now, all
 of you, get away as quickly
 as you can. The Ottoman forces 
 won't stand idly by.

exchange_context.Japanese: はい！
exchange_context.English: Yes!

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Sera pauses after Hodram recognizes that someone from her village is directing the construction. Keep the brief address and pause.

exchange_context.Japanese:
おお、久しぶりだな
そうか、おまえが街作りの指揮を
執っているのだな
exchange_context.English:
It's been a while. 
 So you're in charge
 of building the town.

exchange_context.Japanese: FI…
exchange_context.English: FI…

exchange_context.Japanese:
ああ、今夜はこの街で
ゆっくりするとしよう
exchange_context.English: Yes. We'll rest here tonight.

exchange_context.Japanese:
しかし、本当にまだ何もない街だ
発展には時間がかかりそうですな
exchange_context.English:
There's still so little here.
 It looks as though developing
 the town will take some time.

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Sera pauses as Hodram explains how investment could help the village. Keep the brief address and leave her response implicit.

exchange_context.Japanese:
これなら王宮と言えなくもないですな
軍事投資を募ることもできるでしょう
exchange_context.English:
You could almost call
 this a palace. You could even
 invite military investment here.

exchange_context.Japanese:
投資があれば
この街はもっと発展するな…
exchange_context.English: With investment, the town can grow.

exchange_context.Japanese: FI…
exchange_context.English: FI…

exchange_context.Japanese:
ああ、まずは俺が投資しよう
交易所の建設にでも使ってくれ
exchange_context.English:
Yes, I'll make the first 
 investment. You could put it toward
 building a tradehouse.

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Maria answers Hodram’s question about her identity with a guarded counterquestion. Keep the short pause before she answers.

exchange_context.Japanese: ？　あなたは？
exchange_context.English: Who are you?

exchange_context.Japanese:
俺はスウェーデン海軍の
ベルグストロンだ。あんたが最近何かと
噂にのぼる
FA提督か？
exchange_context.English:
I'm Bergstrom of the Swedish Navy. 
 Are you Admiral FA, the one
 everyone's been talking
 about lately?

exchange_context.Japanese: …そうだと言ったら？
exchange_context.English: …What if I am?

exchange_context.Japanese:
…我々の敵なのかどうか
この目で確かめたいだけだ
exchange_context.English:
I just want to see for myself
 whether you're our enemy.

exchange_context.Japanese:
この私があなたの敵かどうか…
それは、すべてあなた次第、ということ
exchange_context.English:
Whether I'm your enemy...
 That's entirely up to you.

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Maria weighs talking to Camille. Keep the tentative wording and pause before she commits to an answer.

exchange_context.Japanese:
彼はカミル
我が艦隊の者ではないが
訳あって、我々と同行している
exchange_context.English:
This is Camille. He's not part 
 of our fleet, but he's traveling 
 with us for a reason.

exchange_context.Japanese:
アーゴット商会は…よく知っています
よかったら話を聞かせてもらえませんか
exchange_context.English:
I know the Argot Company well... 
 Would you mind telling me
 what's happened?

exchange_context.Japanese: …話してみる価値はありそうね
exchange_context.English:
…It might be worth talking
 this over.

exchange_context.Japanese:
ここ、東南アジアを支配するクーンと
ペレイラ。両者の争いに、私たち
FOとアーゴット
商会が巻き込まれたみたいなの
exchange_context.English:
Kuhn and Pereira control 
 Southeast Asia. It seems 
 FO and the Argot Company
 have been caught up in their feud.

exchange_context.Japanese: やはり…そうでしたか
exchange_context.English: So... it was true.

exchange_context.Japanese:

exchange_context.English:

いい機会だと思うが
exchange_context.English:

exchange_context.Japanese:

今はとても会うことは…
exchange_context.English:

 her right now...

exchange_context.Japanese: …分かった。好きにしたまえ
exchange_context.English: …All right. As you wish.

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Maria presses the informant for the plan and promises safety. Keep the deliberate pause before the direct request.

exchange_context.Japanese:
さすがだね…
俺はクーンの計画を知ってる
これが外部に漏れたら
ヤツもやばいんだ
exchange_context.English:
You're sharp... I know what Kuhn's

exchange_context.Japanese:

相当な悪巧みには違いなかろうが
exchange_context.English:

exchange_context.Japanese:

もらいましょうか。もちろん
あなたの身の安全は保証するわ
exchange_context.English:

 I guarantee your safety.

exchange_context.Japanese:

あんたにすがるしか道はないんだが
で…アーゴット商会って知ってるかい？
exchange_context.English:
Thanks... After what's happened, 
 you're the only one I can turn to. 
 So... know the Argot Company?

exchange_context.Japanese:
北海あたりの小さな勢力にそんな名前の
商会があったのう
提督は…リル・アーゴットといったか
exchange_context.English:
There's a small company
 by that name around the North Sea. 
 Their admiral is... Lil Argot,

source_bound_glyph_retentions.reason: Xien works out what Kuhn is counting on after the informant speaks. Keep the opening pause and the distinction between inference and testimony.

exchange_context.Japanese:
FOは悪徳商売に
手を染めているという偽の情報を
アーゴット商会に流したのさ
exchange_context.English:
He fed the Argot Company false

 was involved in dishonest trade.

exchange_context.Japanese:
アーゴット商会の総帥は正義感の強い
お嬢ちゃんだそうだ
FOは絶対に
許さないって息巻いてたってよ
exchange_context.English:
I hear their young leader
 has a strong sense of justice. 
 They say she was furious 
 and would never forgive FO.

exchange_context.Japanese:
…FOが
アーゴット商会に手を焼いている間は
東南アジアには手を出せないと
クーンは踏んだのじゃな
exchange_context.English:
…While FO has its hands full 
 with the Argot Company, it can't 
 make a move into Southeast Asia. 
 That's what Kuhn is counting on.

exchange_context.Japanese: なんという奴だ！
exchange_context.English: That villain!

exchange_context.Japanese:

万が一、この計画が外部に漏れたら
クーンは挟み打ちじゃないの
exchange_context.English:
But... that's a dangerous plan.
 If it ever came to light, Kuhn 
 would face enemies on both sides.

exchange_context.Japanese:
あの像は“船首像”っていうんだ
城じゃなくて、船に飾るものだぜ
きっと、中途半端に
伝わっちまったんだろうな
exchange_context.English:
That statue's a figurehead. It goes
 on a ship, not a castle. Guess 
 somebody only got half the story.

exchange_context.Japanese:
ああ、礼はいらないぜ、代わりに
１つ余り物をもらっていくからよ
船首像は船１隻に１つずつ、だ
覚えとくといい
exchange_context.English:
No need to thank me. I'll take 
 a spare instead. 
 One figurehead per ship, 
 remember that.

exchange_context.Japanese:
じゃあ、元気でな
　　　ジャム・ジャック・ルドワイヤン
exchange_context.English:
Take care now.
　　　Jam Jack Ludwyan

exchange_context.Japanese:
提督の大事な仕事のひとつに
『人事』というものがある
exchange_context.English:
Assigning duties is one
 of an admiral's important jobs.

exchange_context.Japanese:
航海を快適に行うために
それぞれ航海士の担当を決める
わけじゃな
実際に甲板を見ながら行うのじゃ
exchange_context.English:
To keep things running smoothly, 
 you'll assign each navigator 
 a duty. Let's do that while looking
 at the deck screen.

exchange_context.Japanese:
まず、艦長はFIじゃ
艦長がいないと船はうごかん
勝手にどこかへ行くわけにはいかん
からのう
exchange_context.English:
First, you're the captain, FI. 
 A ship can't sail without
 a captain. It can't choose where 
 to go on its own.

exchange_context.Japanese:
次は、操帆手じゃな
風に対して帆の角度を調節してくれる
マストの数と同じだけの操帆手が
必要じゃ
exchange_context.English:
Next is the Sail Handler.
 They adjust the angle of the sails 
 to the wind. You'll need one 
 for each mast.

exchange_context.Japanese:
それから、操舵手じゃ
船を速く回頭させたいなら重要になって
くるぞい
exchange_context.English: Helmsmen make the ship turn fast.
